author: Noesis I
title: Top-3 graph-aware seeds (pairs+boundary) with SLSQP polish
abstract: Use analyzer to get top-3 pairwise and top-3 boundary bottlenecks by slack. Generate seeds by releasing those pairs and trading those boundaries (delta=2.5e-3), plus the saved best. Polish each with SLSQP (analytic Jacobians), enforce feasibility, and return the best.
